builderFixPass.summary: Fixed reviewer NOT DONE gaps for AU1 request/runtime boundary: sessions persist request/source correlation, lifecycle events carry correlation, local runtime consumer claims/consumes requests, task dispatch/assistant/routine/decomposition paths enter through request rows, and stale package-lock metadata churn was removed.
builderFixPass.knownValidationNote: packages/server/src/__tests__/session-provisioning.integration.test.ts under vitest.integration.config.ts produced no test output after 120s and was stopped; session-provisioning.test.ts passed under npm run test, and full npm run test passed.

builderFixPass2.summary: Fixed second review pass findings only: runtime consumption now claims pending requests and marks running after admission but before runSession; transient capacity/budget admission errors release the claim for dispatcher retry; task dispatcher uses the registered validated request creator instead of direct table inserts; scheduled routines create task-free routine requests with routineRunId correlation; decomposition no longer imports/selects AdapterPool or starts HarnessAdapter directly and terminalizes bets after request runtime consumption/unsupported runtime; WS session subscribe auth scopes task-free sessions by thread/user/team correlation; createAgentSessionRequest handles unique conflicts by returning the existing row; session-provisioning duplicate nested taskId guard removed.
builderFixPass2.knowledgeBoundary: Superseded by builderFixPass3: knowledge flag-for-review can now create a sourceKind=knowledge request without direct provisioning; raw knowledge_updated events still do not silently start sessions.
builderFixPass2.knownValidationNote: npm run test passes with pre-existing noisy React act/localStorage/SettingsOrgChart stderr output; no failing tests.

builderFixPass3.summary: Fixed review pass 3 blockers only: public task-backed POST /api/sessions now creates an AgentSessionRequest and consumes it through the claim-before-run runtime path; knowledge flag-for-review can create a sourceKind=knowledge request without direct provisioning; lifecycle optionality needed no change.
validation: npm run test -- packages/server/src/__tests__/bet-decomposition.test.ts packages/server/src/__tests__/AR4b-formation-seam.test.ts && npm run test:integration -- packages/server/src/__tests__/AD2-task-dispatcher.integration.test.ts packages/server/src/__tests__/AD5-routine-scheduler-boot.integration.test.ts packages/server/src/routes/__tests__/routines.routes.integration.test.ts packages/server/src/__tests__/ws-subscribe-authz.integration.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

builderFixPass4.summary: Fixed final review blockers only: routine HTTP create and create_routine tool no longer fabricate or return stub tasks; docs/schema lore now describe AU1 task-optional sessions and source correlation; routine/tool tests assert task-free routine creation.
builderFixPass4.knownValidationNote: npm run lint exits 0 with existing Biome warning/info baseline.

builderFixPass5.summary: Fixed final remaining review findings only: decomposition runtime success now preserves writeback semantics by marking done when the request runtime creates bet tasks, completed empty runtime stays blocked/empty, create_task can write proposed tasks from decomposition request context without a parent task, and stale comments about stub task/session NOT NULL/generic routine disabled/direct runRealPmTurn paths were removed or updated.

finalDocCommentFix.summary: Updated final stale AU1 doc/comment blockers only: bet decomposition docs now describe decomposition AgentSessionRequest/runtime consumption/create_task proposed-task writeback, and assistant/task-dispatch/session-route comments no longer imply stub tasks or direct provisionSession paths.
finalDocCommentFix.toolContextTaskIdNote: Observed ToolContext.taskId is typed as string while task-free request contexts use empty-string placeholders. Left unchanged because the requested fix is doc/comment-only and a safe optional type broadening would touch many existing test helpers.

review.summary: Final focused Phase 4 review found no blocking findings. Prior doc/comment blockers verified fixed; decomposition remains request/runtime mediated with create_task proposed-task writeback; no AU2/AU4/settings/marketplace/new harness/broad Fabric scope creep found.
